name: What are the key differences between SEO and SEM for pediatric practices?

mainEntity.name: What are the key differences between SEO and SEM for pediatric practices?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) and SEM (Search Engine Marketing) are distinct but complementary strategies for pediatric practices. SEO focuses on improving your organic search rankings naturally over time through website optimization, content quality, and technical enhancements. SEM encompasses a broader range of tactics, including SEO, but also involves paid advertising methods like Google Ads. While SEO builds long-term organic visibility, SEM can provide immediate traffic through paid placements, offering different approaches to attract patients online.
acceptedAnswer.description: SEO focuses on organic search ranking improvements, while SEM includes both SEO and paid advertising to attract patients, offering different speeds of results.
